[doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_010]

Agents can apply a promotional statement credit using apply_statement_credit_8472, which requires user_id, credit_card_account_id, a positive dollar amount, and a reason value; 'promotional_credit' is the reason for a credit from a promotional offer or campaign. apply_statement_credit_8472 is a discoverable agent tool that must first be unlocked via unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then invoked via call_discoverable_agent_tool with a JSON string of arguments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]
The credit_card_account_id needed for agent-side promotional credits is obtained by calling get_credit_card_accounts_by_user. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

Redeeming accumulated credit card rewards (a different activity from redeeming a promotional offer) can be done through the Rho-Bank mobile app, online banking at rhobank.com, or by calling customer service at 1-800-RHO-BANK. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_024]

New credit card applications are completed online with personal information and income details, consent to a credit check, review of the offer terms, and e-signature to finalize account setup. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]
